fusions.name: Seismic Thump
fusions.desc: Thumps a hind foot on the ground, dealing 3 earth damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Erupting Burrow
fusions.desc: Tunnels you to a target up to 6 tiles away and bursts up beneath it, dealing 15 earth damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone to Ground
fusions.desc: You drop into the ground and come up 3 tiles away. For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Bolt-Hole
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
